submit = async () => {
    if (blocked) return
    setBusy(true)
    setCreateError(null)
    const label = workspaceName || source?.item.title || (fromBranch ? branch.trim() : placeholder) || 'new workspace'
    const clearPending = onPending(repoId, label)
    let result: WorktreeCreateResult | typeof SETUP_CHOICE_NEEDED | null
    try {
      result = await createWorkspace(context, fields(), hooks)
    } catch (error) {
      setCreateError(messageOf(error))
      return
    } finally {
      clearPending()
      setBusy(false)
    }
    if (result === SETUP_CHOICE_NEEDED) {
      setChoiceDemanded(true)
      setAdvanced(true)
      return
    }
    if (!result) return
    if (!createMore) return onClose()
    resetFocusPending.current = true
    sourceRequest.current += 1
    setSelectedSource(null)
    setSourceBusy(false)
    setSourceError(null)
    setSearch(null)
    setBranch('')
    setSmartInput('')
    setName('')
    setQuery('')
    setAgent('')
    setModel('')
    setLaunchPicks({})
    setAgentOptionsState(null)
    setSparsePathsText('')
    setKeepMain(false)
    setPrompt('')
    setSubmitPrompt(null)
    setSetupChoice(null)
    setChoiceDemanded(false)
    setSuggestion((n) => n + 1)
  }
